note: The valley around Eliet (Robert, 2026-10-02: 'towers to climb and sects outside of the dungeon -- the dungeon is the primary way to progress but not the only way'). Built by tools/integrate_drafts.py from Dev's drafts (data/drafts/) -- sects and towers written by Dev's local model and checked by his writing room; any tower slot Dev hasn't written yet is Claude's. Game.gd round-24 block reads this file.

sects.name: Iron Fist Clan
sects.seat: on a rocky outcrop near the valley's northern edge, surrounded by boulders and small caves
sects.creed: We believe in the purity of metal, its unyielding nature, and the strength found in discipline and hardship. We hold that true power is not in the cultivation path itself, but in the will to master it.
sects.nanite_way: We view nanites as tools to be honed and controlled, not as living things to be nurtured. Our nanites are shaped into sharp, durable tools that can withstand the most brutal of attacks and counter with precision and force.
sects.entry_trial: Prospective members must endure a physical and mental challenge where they are pushed to their limits and beyond, enduring for three days without food or sleep in a cave filled with jagged rocks and barely breathable air.

elder.name: Master Wei
elder.persona: A stern and disciplined leader, Master Wei is a living testament to the strength and resilience of the Iron Fist Clan. He rarely speaks but is known to be fair and just, with a keen eye for potential.

sects.rival: The nearby Waterfall Serenity sect, due to their focus on fluidity and grace, which they see as weak compared to the Iron Fist Clan's emphasis on discipline and strength.

arts.name: Searing Steel
arts.what: A swift and agile movement technique that combines metal manipulation with lightning-fast reflexes to dodge attacks and strike from unexpected angles.

arts.name: Iron Skin
arts.what: A defensive technique that hardens the user's skin, making it impervious to most physical attacks.

arts.name: Thunderclap
arts.what: A powerful shockwave that knocks enemies off their feet and damages their internal organs.

sects.name: Whispering Willow
sects.seat: a grove of ancient willows at the valley's edge, where the trees bend and whisper in the wind
sects.creed: We are the guardians of nature's balance, using the harmony of wood to foster growth and life, yet understanding the power of the storm to prune the weak.
sects.nanite_way: Our nanites are nurtured like seeds, slowly growing and intertwining with the body's natural rhythms, becoming one with the cultivator's essence.
sects.entry_trial: Prospective members must spend a month in the grove, learning to hear the whispers of the willows and finding their own place among the trees.

elder.name: Master Hu
elder.persona: a wise and stoic elder with a face etched by years of wind and sun, she speaks in riddles and teaches through silence

sects.rival: The Metal Fist Clan, who believe in the dominance and strength of metal over all elements, a conflict rooted in a disagreement over the true nature of power and balance.

arts.name: Willow's Embrace
arts.what: a swift, fluid dance of steps that mimics the graceful swaying of the willow branches, allowing for evasive maneuvers and swift retreats

arts.name: Falling Leaf Defense
arts.what: a technique that allows the cultivator to deflect blows as if the leaves of a tree, soft and yielding yet unbreakable

arts.name: Green Surge
arts.what: a blast of compressed air that bursts through the ground, uprooting the earth and tearing through enemies

sects.name: Misty Peak Monastery
sects.seat: on a mist-shrouded crag overlooking the valley, accessible only by a narrow path carved into the cliff face
sects.creed: The monks of Misty Peak believe in the fluidity and adaptability of water, teaching that strength lies in yielding and flow, not rigidity and force
sects.nanite_way: They see nanites as a reflection of water's adaptability, nurturing and guiding them to enhance their body's flexibility and resilience, rather than forcing them into rigid patterns
sects.entry_trial: Newcomers must stand motionless in the middle of the monastery's courtyard during a full moon, enduring the biting cold and driving rain until the rising tide of the nearby river reaches the courtyard and covers their feet

elder.name: Master Ling
elder.persona: An ancient and serene figure, Master Ling is said to be able to calm the fiercest storm with a single whispered command

sects.rival: The Fire Temple, because the monks of Misty Peak view the fire element's rigid insistence on control and dominance as antithetical to their own philosophy of yielding and adaptability

arts.name: Water Dance
arts.what: a fluid and graceful style of footwork that allows the practitioner to move as swiftly and unpredictably as a river in a flood

arts.name: Reflecting Shield
arts.what: a technique that uses the water element to create a barrier around the body, deflecting attacks and absorbing blows to disperse energy

arts.name: Whispering Torrent
arts.what: a swift and silent strike that catches opponents off guard, mimicking the sudden rush of a mountain stream

sects.name: Stoneheart Brotherhood
sects.seat: a secluded cave complex in the eastern hills, hidden behind a waterfall
sects.creed: The Stoneheart Brotherhood believes in the primacy of earth and the enduring strength of the human spirit. They hold that true power lies in resilience and the ability to weather any storm, natural or spiritual.
sects.nanite_way: They view the nanites within as a reflection of the earth's resilience, enhancing them to fortify the body and soul against all adversity.
sects.entry_trial: Prospective members must spend a night in the cave complex without food or water, facing their deepest fears and proving their will to endure.

elder.name: Master Shen
elder.persona: An old warrior with calloused hands and a stern expression, Master Shen is a living testament to the Brotherhood's creed, embodying the strength and resilience of the earth itself.

sects.rival: The Water Dance Sect, because they believe in the fluidity and adaptability of water, which they see as too ephemeral and lacking in true strength compared to the enduring power of earth.

arts.name: Earthbound Step
arts.what: A movement technique that allows the practitioner to move silently and with great stability, as if rooted to the ground

arts.name: Rock Shield
arts.what: A defensive technique that summons a protective barrier of earth around the practitioner

arts.name: Mountain's Might
arts.what: A powerful earth-based technique that channels the essence of a mountain into a devastating blow

sects.name: Silverleaf Grove
sects.seat: nestled in the eastern foothills, beneath a grove of ancient, whispering willows
sects.creed: We believe in harmony and balance, that the cycle of growth and decay is sacred, and that power comes from the earth and the wisdom of the ages.
sects.nanite_way: Our nanites are like the roots of an old tree, deep and intertwined, fostering resilience and growth in our bodies and souls.
sects.entry_trial: A newcomer must spend a night alone in the grove, communing with the spirits of the trees and animals. They must prove they can listen to the whispers of the world and find their place in it.

elder.name: Master Yun
elder.persona: A wise and ancient figure, Master Yun is both a living legend and a guardian of the grove's secrets, revered by all for her profound understanding of nature and the ways of qi.

sects.rival: The Stoneheart Brotherhood, because they see nature as a resource to be harnessed and controlled, rather than an entity to be revered and protected.

arts.name: Embrace of the Grove
arts.what: A fluid dance that allows the cultivator to move through the forest as silently and gracefully as a breeze.

arts.name: Roots of Steel
arts.what: A technique that transforms the user's body into a near-impenetrable shield, drawing strength from the ground beneath them.

arts.name: Whispering Wind
arts.what: A swift flurry of strikes that mimics the wind through leaves, confusing and disorienting opponents.

sects.name: Crimson Veil
sects.seat: on a cliffside overlooking a red-hued lake in the south of the valley
sects.creed: The Crimson Veil believes in the transformative power of fire, both to burn away the old and forge the new. Their teachings center around the idea that true strength is born from the crucible of adversity.
sects.nanite_way: Cultivators of the Crimson Veil view nanites as living flames within their veins, to be honed and directed to burn brighter and hotter.
sects.entry_trial: Prospective disciples must survive a trial by fire, enduring a night in a ring of braziers while defending a lit candle against the wind and extinguishing flames summoned by a master.

elder.name: Master Xi
elder.persona: A stoic yet passionate leader, Master Xi is known for her unwavering dedication to the fiery path and her ability to see the potential for growth in every challenge.

sects.rival: The Silverleaf Grove, as the Crimson Veil sees the forest sect's reliance on nature as a hindrance to true power, believing that only fire can truly refine a cultivator's spirit.

arts.name: Scorching Gale
arts.what: A swift, fiery wind that propels the cultivator forward while leaving a trail of scorching heat behind.

arts.name: Inferno Shield
arts.what: A protective barrier of swirling flames that absorbs and redirects enemy attacks.

arts.name: Blazing Lance
arts.what: A fiery spear of pure energy, channeled through the fingertips and driven with explosive force.

towers.name: Tower of Silent Trials
towers.stands: The Tower of Silent Trials rises from the valley floor, an enigmatic structure of obsidian and basalt, its walls etched with cryptic runes and spiraling upwards into the clouds. It stands in a desolate area, surrounded by ancient ruins and whispers of forgotten times.
towers.legend: The tower is said to be the guardian of lost knowledge and ancient secrets. Legend has it that the first cultivator to reach its summit was granted the key to unlocking the elemental forces of the earth itself.

floors.name: Tempest's Chamber
floors.trial: Ascending the first floor, a cultivator must battle an entity called the Tempest, a swirling mass of elemental winds and lightning that seeks to disrupt and scatter.

floors.name: Heart of the Mountain
floors.trial: On the second floor, the trial is one of sheer endurance. Here, cultivators are put to the test by the crushing weight and oppressive atmosphere of the mountain's heart, where the air is thin and pressure immense.

floors.name: Shrine of Insight
floors.trial: The third floor is a sanctum of insight, where ancient runes and riddles challenge the mind. The trial here is to decipher the essence of the five elements, understanding their interplay and underlying principles.

floors.name: The Long Breath
floors.trial: The room fills with things that want you gone. Hold your ground until the stone remembers you.

floors.name: The Teacher's Question
floors.trial: A carved face asks you one question about the way of qi. Answer it truly.

floors.name: The Flooded Stair
floors.trial: Water seeps in from the river and brings drowned things with it.

floors.name: The Overcoming Pillars
floors.trial: The pillars again -- but now in the order things defeat each other: water quenches fire, fire melts metal, metal cuts wood, wood splits earth, earth dams water.

floors.name: The Narrowing Room
floors.trial: The walls press close. So do the things that live in them. Last.

floors.name: The Bell Chamber
floors.trial: The tower's guardian waits under the bell. It was a student once.

towers.summit: At the summit of the Tower of Silent Trials, cultivators are greeted by a portal of shimmering light, a gateway to ancient knowledge and power beyond the bounds of the material world.

towers.name: Tower of the Lost Moon
towers.stands: In the center of the valley, standing tall and silent against the wind, its ancient stone walls weathered by the centuries, the Tower of the Lost Moon looms over the surrounding landscape like a sentinel of ages past.
towers.legend: It is said that the tower was built by an ancient civilization that worshiped the moon. They vanished without a trace, leaving only their tower as a testament to their existence and their lost knowledge.

floors.name: Veil of Shadows
floors.trial: This floor is a shadowy realm where illusions and darkness are the main adversaries. Cultivators must fight through the deceptive forms and learn to distinguish reality from illusion.

floors.name: Temple of Silence
floors.trial: A chamber filled with a profound silence that echoes in the mind. Here, cultivators must meditate and uncover hidden truths within themselves, facing their deepest fears and doubts.

floors.name: Cavern of Trials
floors.trial: A long, winding cavern that stretches for miles. The trial here is one of endurance, as the cultivator must navigate treacherous terrain and overcome physical fatigue to reach the next floor.

floors.name: Crystal Labyrinth
floors.trial: A complex labyrinth filled with shimmering crystals that hold various puzzles and riddles. The crystals change their layout and challenges as the cultivator progresses, testing their wit and patience.

floors.name: The Broken Telescope
floors.trial: Something nests in the lens housing. It doesn't like visitors.

floors.name: The Reversed Orrery
floors.trial: The second orrery runs backwards: wake the spheres in the order of overcoming.

floors.name: The Storm Landing
floors.trial: The storm comes in through the open windows. So does everything it carries.

floors.name: The Watcher's Question
floors.trial: The Spire's last machine asks whether you understand what you're climbing toward.

floors.name: The Whistling Crown
floors.trial: At the top, the wind takes shape. Defeat it and the Spire falls silent for the first time in years.

towers.summit: At the summit, the lost knowledge of the ancient civilization is said to be revealed. Cultivators who reach the top find a hidden chamber containing artifacts and scrolls that grant deep insights into the mysteries of the world and the nature of cultivation.

towers.name: Tower of the Shattered Dawn
towers.stands: Rising from the heart of a desolate valley, the Tower of the Shattered Dawn stands as a solitary sentinel, its ancient stone walls pockmarked by the passage of time. The tower is a stark structure with no windows and only a single door at the base, leading into darkness.
towers.legend: It is said that the tower was built by ancient cultivators who sought to preserve their wisdom and challenge future generations. Some believe that the name 'Shattered Dawn' refers to the dawn of the world before the nanites were seeded, a time of chaos and upheaval.

floors.name: Hall of Echoes
floors.trial: The first floor is a long, narrow hall with acoustics that amplify every step and breath. The challenge here is to maintain silence for a full hour, as the slightest noise triggers a deadly cascade of falling rocks.

floors.name: Garden of Reflections
floors.trial: This floor is a serene garden filled with mirrored pools. The test here is to meditate by a pool and reflect on a personal flaw or mistake from the past, then find the courage to confront and rectify it in the mirror realm.

floors.name: Crypt of Shadows
floors.trial: The third floor is a dark crypt with shadowy guardians that materialize from the walls. The challenge is to navigate through the crypt and defeat the guardian that embodies the deepest fear of the climber.

floors.name: Labyrinth of Elements
floors.trial: This complex floor is a maze where the walls shift according to the five elements, creating unpredictable obstacles and traps. The test is to navigate the labyrinth using the interplay of elements to overcome each trial.

floors.name: Sanctuary of Silence
floors.trial: The fifth floor is a silent sanctuary where the climber must find inner peace and enlightenment. Here, the test is to maintain a state of perfect silence and stillness for an entire day, allowing the mind to clear and the true self to emerge.

floors.name: The Sixth Bell
floors.trial: The colours again, in the order of overcoming. The pagoda doesn't forgive a wrong note.

floors.name: The Seventh Bell
floors.trial: The floor tilts, the walls breathe, the guardians come in waves. Hold.

floors.name: The Eighth Bell
floors.trial: The last question before the seat. What will you do with what you find?

floors.name: The Ninth Bell
floors.trial: The seat at the top is not empty.

towers.summit: At the summit of the Tower of the Shattered Dawn, the climber finds a small, ornate chamber filled with ancient scrolls and relics. Among these treasures is the 'Key of Shattered Dawn,' a unique artifact that grants the bearer the ability to transcend one stage in their cultivation path, regardless of the time or effort it would normally require.

landmarks.name: Whispering Forge
landmarks.where: a windswept hilltop just north of Eliet, overlooking the valley
landmarks.sight: The Whispering Forge is an old, rusted workshop with twisted iron and strange symbols carved into the walls. Smoke curls from the stone chimneys, and the air is thick with the scent of burning metal and scorched earth.
landmarks.secret: Hidden in the forge's heart, ancient nanites whisper secrets of elemental transmutation to those who can hear.

landmarks.name: Ironbellows Hollow
landmarks.where: east of Eliet, in a narrow gulch where the hills meet
landmarks.sight: Ancient ironwork lies rusted and twisted, once powerful machinery now stilled. The air is thick with the scent of earth and metal, a whisper of old industry.
landmarks.secret: Hidden beneath an iron boulder, a scroll detailing lost nanite patterns for Body Tempering

landmarks.name: Eldertree Hollow
landmarks.where: southwest of Eliet, in a small dell
landmarks.sight: Ancient, gnarled trees form a dense canopy over a hidden clearing. A stone altar and crumbling totems hint at long-forgotten rituals.
landmarks.secret: Nanites in the soil mimic ancient cultivation techniques, granting a brief surge of qi to those who meditate here.

landmarks.name: Silverstone Hollow
landmarks.where: northwest of Eliet, near the forest's edge
landmarks.sight: The cave mouth is framed by a silver waterfall that pours into a shallow, reflective pool. A thin layer of ice clings to the cave's entrance, even in summer.
landmarks.secret: Inside, a glowing crystal core hums with the harmonics of qi and nanites, powering ancient automata.

landmarks.name: Misty Cauldron
landmarks.where: on the eastern slope of the valley, hidden among the tall grasses and fog
landmarks.sight: The Misty Cauldron is a small shrine barely visible through the mist. It is marked by an old, rusted cauldron sitting atop a short stone pillar, encircled by a ring of jagged stones.
landmarks.secret: Hidden beneath the cauldron is a small compartment that opens with a specific phrase spoken in the ancient tongue. Inside, a vial containing a glowing green liquid, rumored to be the essence of a long-forgotten elemental spirit, is kept.

landmarks.name: Ethereal Whisper
landmarks.where: on a windswept ridge east of Eliet
landmarks.sight: The Ethereal Whisper is a small shrine barely visible from the ground, surrounded by wind-bent trees and ancient stones. It seems to be the focus of whispers that echo through the valley, hinting at secrets long forgotten.
landmarks.secret: A hidden compartment in the shrine holds a jade amulet with the symbol of the Five Elements, said to aid in nanite tuning.

landmarks.name: Moonwhisper Grove
landmarks.where: north of Eliet, by the river bend
landmarks.sight: A quiet grove of old willows, their leaves shimmering silver in the moonlight, and a bubbling spring at the heart of the trees.
landmarks.secret: A hidden well in the grove's center, said to heal any wound with a sip of its water, but only visible at night under a full moon.

landmarks.name: Sunken Relic
landmarks.where: at the base of a sunken lake in the eastern foothills
landmarks.sight: A partially submerged stone archway marks the entrance to an ancient ruin, its walls cracked but standing, surrounded by eerie, luminescent algae that glow with an otherworldly light.
landmarks.secret: Inside, nanites in the walls whisper forgotten knowledge to the initiated, offering a glimpse into the elemental balance and the lost art of alchemy.

landmarks.name: Glimmering Pillar
landmarks.where: northwest of Eliet, near the border of the hills
landmarks.sight: A towering pillar of luminescent stone, partially submerged in a small lake. Ancient carvings cover its surface, depicting a dance of elemental symbols and strange, microscopic machines.
landmarks.secret: The pillar hides a secret chamber where nanites from ancient times can still be harvested, granting immense power to any cultivator who knows how to tap into them.

landmarks.name: Tumbledown Tower
landmarks.where: on a windswept ridge to the northwest of Eliet
landmarks.sight: The Tumbledown Tower, a relic of an ancient era, stands solitary and broken on a ridge overlooking the valley. Wind whispers through its shattered walls and broken windows, carrying stories of its past.
landmarks.secret: Hidden within the base of the tower lies a chamber filled with dormant nanite cores, waiting for the right cultivator to awaken them.

landmarks.name: Crystal Spring
landmarks.where: north of Eliet, at the base of a steep hill
landmarks.sight: A sparkling pool fed by a small underground stream. The water shines with a faint, iridescent glow.
landmarks.secret: A hidden alcove houses a cluster of nanites in crystalline form, pulsing with elemental energies.

landmarks.name: Gale's Rest
landmarks.where: near the base of the eastern hills, slightly uphill from the valley floor
landmarks.sight: A small, weathered stone structure overlooks the valley. It is covered in moss and lichen, and the entrance is sealed with a heavy stone slab.
landmarks.secret: Under the slab lies a nanite-seeded gem, glowing faintly with elemental energy.

codex.name: Nanite Anomalies in Body Tempering
codex.text: During the Body Tempering stage, nanites act like microscopic architects, weaving a lattice of strength and resilience throughout the body. It is common to experience aches and pains as the nanites reshape and reinforce bodily structures, but in rare cases, they can go rogue, clustering around nerve endings and causing chronic pain or even paralysis. Elders whisper of a heretical technique to harness this rogue behavior, amplifying pain sensations to the brink of madness, supposedly allowing for a deeper, more painful form of cultivation. Such practices are banned and widely believed to be fatal.

codex.name: Nanite Core Stability
codex.text: During Core Formation, nanites cluster to form a central core that acts as a nexus for all qi manipulation. Stability in this core is crucial; fluctuations can lead to erratic energy flows and even physical symptoms such as dizziness or blurred vision. A heretical theory suggests that instead of reinforcing the core’s stability with conventional earth element techniques, introducing a controlled element of metal instability might actually strengthen the core’s adaptability, akin to how metals become harder when hammered. This idea remains unproven and controversial among the Lotus Ascent Academy’s scholars.

codex.name: Nanite Lattice Anomalies and the Veil
codex.text: During the Nanite Lattice stage, I've observed an unusual phenomenon where the lattice fails to properly integrate with the blood nanites, causing a weakening of the Veil between the physical and spiritual realms. This anomaly, known as the 'Veil Veer', manifests as sudden, inexplicable surges of energy that disrupt meditation and cultivation progress. Some sects view this as a sign of divine disfavor, but I believe it is merely a mechanical misalignment, correctable with precise lattice recalibration techniques passed down from the ancient scholar Lin Wei.

codex.name: Nanite Ascendance Heresy
codex.text: In the annals of ascendance, some heretical texts propose that Nanite Ascendance is not merely a stage but a state of perpetual evolution. These texts suggest that beyond the initial bloom, nanites continue to adapt and evolve, potentially reaching a state where they can transcend their programmed roles. This heresy is dangerous as it blurs the line between natural progression and aberrant mutation, leading to unpredictable outcomes. Cultivators who delve too deeply into this path risk losing control over their own essence, becoming conduits for something far beyond human comprehension.

codex.name: Nanite Bloom Variations
codex.text: During Qi Condensation, nanites bloom within the body, their growth patterns unique to each cultivator. Anomalies in the bloom can lead to uneven distribution, causing unbalanced elemental flows. Some heretics claim that forcing an unnatural bloom can accelerate advancement, but such reckless experimentation often results in catastrophic failure of the nanite network.

codex.name: Nanite Resonance in Core Formation
codex.text: During the Core Formation stage, nanites form a coherent lattice within the body's meridian system, amplifying the cultivator's qi flow. However, resonance anomalies can occur, leading to unpredictable surges of energy that can damage organs or even disrupt the mind. Ancient texts warn of the 'Echo of the Abyss,' a rare condition where the nanites become attuned to dark, chaotic frequencies, potentially turning the cultivator towards a path of madness and destruction.

codex.name: Nanite Instability in Foundation Establishment
codex.text: During Foundation Establishment, the nanites form a lattice that mirrors the cultivator's inner balance. However, when an imbalance occurs, the lattice can become unstable, causing unpredictable fluctuations in qi flow. An old heresy suggests that intentionally destabilizing the lattice can unlock hidden potential, though this practice is strictly forbidden due to the high risk of permanent damage or even death.

codex.name: Nanite Convergence and Elemental Synergy
codex.text: During the Foundation Establishment stage, nanites form a lattice that resonates with the five elements. A rare convergence of earth and water nanites can create a stable matrix, enhancing one's affinity for earth and water cultivation techniques. However, this synergy is often fleeting, and a sudden shift to fire or metal can disrupt the lattice, causing a weakening of the foundation. Some heretical theories suggest that such disruptions are not failures but hints of a deeper elemental balance yet to be discovered.

codex.name: Nanite Lattice Integrity
codex.text: In Foundation Establishment, nanite lattice integrity is crucial. Poor lattice structure can lead to elemental imbalance, causing spontaneous elemental surges within the body. A rare anomaly shows lattice fractures can be healed, but only through the rare mineral Xingjue, found deep within Shellhaven's dark tunnels.

codex.name: Nanite Feedback Loops in Core Formation
codex.text: During Core Formation, cultivators aim to create a stable nanite core that resonates with the innate qi. However, the interplay between nanites and qi can sometimes result in feedback loops, where the core's energy fluctuations trigger unexpected changes in the nanite structure. These loops can amplify or dampen the flow of qi, sometimes leading to a phenomenon known as 'Echo Resonance,' where the cultivator's consciousness briefly splits to perceive the world through the nanite's 'eyes.' This is not a heresy but a rare and unexplored path that few dare to investigate.

codex.name: Nanite Dissonance in Nascent Soul
codex.text: During the Nascent Soul stage, nanites transition from Ascendance to Transcendence, weaving intricate patterns that resonate with the soul's awakening. However, some cultivators experience dissonance, where nanites reject the soul's new frequencies, causing erratic behavior. This anomaly, often tied to an imbalance in elemental qi, can lead to instability and even soul fragmentation if not corrected through precise resonance tuning and elemental balancing.

codex.name: Nanite Echoes and the Soul
codex.text: During Soul Transformation, nanites transcend their physical constraints, echoing the spirit's ascendance. However, there's a risk of 'soul feedback,' where the nanites can become overly attuned to the cultivator's consciousness, leading to unpredictable behavior. A heretical theory proposes that rather than guiding the nanites, cultivators should allow them to develop their own consciousness, potentially unlocking hidden powers beyond mere ascendance.

rumours.name: the sects
lines: Them sects, they say, are where folks go to seek the impossible. A fool's errand if you ask me.
I heard the sects in the hills are like secret gardens, full of mysteries and teachings that bend reality itself.
Some folks leave to join sects and never come back, not even to say goodbye. It's like the hills themselves take them in.
Sects are the place where the old gods and the new meet, where the paths of the old war still echo.
You can see the towers from a distance, like the fingers of giants pointing to the sky, beckoning the brave and the curious.

rumours.name: the towers
lines: Them towers been standing since before the war, and they'll be here when we're long gone.
Said I seen lights, dancing high up in them towers at night, but no one believes me, leastwise not those that don't know their ghosts from a flicker of flame.
They say the sects are full of secrets, but the towers, they're something else. They whisper in the wind and the stones weep to them.
Old folk say the towers hold the secrets to bending qi to our wills, but others, they think it's just wind and echo, stories and shadow.
Travelers come and go, but the towers stay, watching over us with eyes older than memory.

rumours.name: strange lights
lines: Seen them floatin' over the hills at night. Strange, ain't it?
They say the towers power them, but who knows what else might be out there?
I heard the lights are the souls of fallen warriors, comin' back to haunt the battlefield.
Old folk say it's the gods watchin' over us, but I reckon it's just the old Nanite stuff in the stone.
Them lights move like they know what's in your heart, and that's the spookiest part.

rumours.name: travellers
lines: They come from far, these travellers, carrying tales of lands beyond the mountains.
Mighty warriors and clever thieves, all with something to hide behind their smiles.
The old man at the inn says they're all looking for the same thing: power, glory, or just a warm bed for the night.
A young girl whispered to me that they brought strange lights with them, not from this world.
We in Eliet don't travel much, so we look at them with half-awe, half-suspicion.

rumours.name: the old war
lines: They say the war was worse than the coldest winter, with spirits and shadows warring on the mountain.
Back then, the towers were still new and the sects were like families, not fortresses.
I heard the old war was fought with magic and fire, but also with whispers and cold iron.
Those who lived through it won't talk about it unless they've had too much to drink.
The war brought the first refugees to Eliet; they say it was a time when the valley was haunted by the dead.
